statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations
The patient has transient neurological deficits suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The diagnosis codes are G45.9, I47.1, and I49.5
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
